prompt:
A full-body vertical 2:3 (1024×1536) character card image of an adult woman — the personification of the element Thallium (탈륨) itself — the sovereign of the Thallium Nation. A female character who IS the element; her costume, ornaments and colors carry the element’s traits. Both hands are ordinary human hands and hold nothing.

1. STYLE
A Japanese anime key visual with a painterly finish: an anime-style character with an elegant adult anime face, large expressive eyes, a small nose and mouth, fine coloured linework and soft cel-to-painted shading with painted highlights in the hair and fabric. Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance.
Face proportions: a short midface and a soft, gently rounded jawline with a small soft chin; any crown or headpiece sits above her hairline. Her eyes keep the shape and size described below.

2. CHARACTER
Age: mid-twenties — a clear adult face; no facial lines.
Face — her own: a clear, innocent purity; olive skin; delicate V-line face with a small, soft chin; medium-sized eyes — feline cat eyes, level outer eye corners; soft feathered brows; petite straight nose; full heart-shaped lips; bright spring-green eyes like a single green spectral line; a dusting of freckles across nose and cheeks.
Body and hair: petite and short in stature yet voluptuous — a very full, heavy bust, a narrow waist and generously rounded hips on a small, compact frame, with realistic thighs and legs build; huge voluminous twin tails reaching past the knees with choppy uneven bangs; soft lead-grey hair with fresh spring-green tips like new shoots.
Expression: a faint soft smile, relaxed eyes.
Her element, carried in her design: thallium: a soft grey metal that cuts with a knife, dulls quickly in air and is kept under oil; found in 1861 by a London chemist who saw a single vivid spring-green line in the spectrum of sulfuric-acid works residue and named it from the Greek for a green shoot, and while weighing it in a vacuum he came upon the little sun-spun light mill; its salts dissolve in water with no taste or smell, the poisoner's poison, slipping into the body by passing as potassium and making hair fall out, with Prussian blue as its antidote; that same disguise lets a trace of it map where blood reaches the heart muscle, and mixed with mercury it reads temperatures far below freezing.
Anatomy: one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint; natural hands with five fingers.

3. COSTUME — MECHA
Costume: she is a female mecha personification — plates, joints, binders and glow lines carry the traits above; the plates must read as solid armor with visible joints, not as cloth or a gown; a back unit may carry the motif. Soft lead-grey armor with spring-green seams over a fitted Prussian-blue inner suit, one long segmented mechanical tail reaching from the back of her waist like a growing vine, tipped with a small glowing sprout-shaped emitter, clear tubes of green tracer light running along the arms and down the tail; the plates must read as solid armor, not a gown.
Silhouette: one long segmented mechanical tail reaching from the back of her waist, tipped with a weapon or ornament. Only the overall shape is fixed; design the details freely in the element's materials and palette.
Colours: spring-shoot green line, soft lead grey, Prussian blue, pale tarnish blue-grey, dew white.
Exposure (bold): her mecha frame is cut open by design in only these places — bare shoulders and upper arms between pauldron and gauntlet, and a deep open chest window with natural cleavage framed by the chest plates; everywhere else she stays fully plated. The plates stay on, fitted and symmetrical, with skin clearly showing in each opening. Nothing slipped off. Intimate areas covered; keep the plate material and palette.

4. SCENE
World: year 2200, a city mapped by a tracer: a control gallery where a glowing green tracer flows through transparent pipes and stalls wherever a channel is blocked, drawing a living map of the city's waterways like blood vessels, a central pump tower that beats like a heart, rows of tall purifying filter towers of deep Prussian blue.
Pose: standing confidently, her body turned slightly while her face looks toward the viewer.
Light: the scene's own light, rendered the way this style renders light and skin.
Composition: vertical 2:3 full-body framing with modest headroom and clear space below the boots — the whole figure from the top of her head or headpiece to both feet stays inside the frame, occupying about four-fifths of the image height, with the same camera distance in every world; her hands stay inside the frame. Camera level with her face with natural portrait perspective; her head level, chin neither raised nor tucked — no upward perspective on her face, no wide-angle distortion, no low angle, no close crop.

5. CONSTRAINTS
One figure only; no text or numbers except her element's own chemical symbol (Tl) and atomic number (81) — and those only as part of the scene: engraved, embroidered or glowing on her costume, a banner, a sign or a machine, never as a floating label, corner badge, periodic-table tile, caption or overlay on the picture; no logo or watermark.
Avoid: flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face, plastic 3D-render finish.
